title: Market event
description: One corporate event row in events.json or a history_<market>.json file.

date.description: ISO date; month-only (YYYY-MM) where the source gives no day

index.description: Index membership at the time of the event, e.g. Nifty 50, S&P 500

period.description: Fiscal period covered, e.g. Q2 FY27, H1 2026

doc_url.description: Company website first, exchange/regulator copy second

source.description: Where the row was read from (e.g. EDGAR, TDnet, DART, ASX, Screener, company IR)
